objective: Integrate a mandatory, fail-closed PreSendGuard gate into ConversationOrchestrator without enabling Transport, real send, or AUTO.
behavior: preSendGuardRequired=true requires both PreSendGuard and request factory.
Missing guard, null request, or denied guard emits SendFailed and returns before SendStarted.
Successful guard evaluation permits the existing send path to continue.
Default behavior remains legacy when preSendGuardRequired is false and no guard is configured.
